comparison.objective: Open a stepladder fully and engage its spreader lock; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR steadies one ladder section while pulling the other against a closing spring until a latch seats. Candidate manipulates a fine screw and collar, then cycles a test carriage.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires full opening, spreader engagement, four feet down, and no fall. Candidate requires two bounded energy-absorption cycles and retained adjustment. PR has no separate spec.
comparison.reason: Large articulated deployment and latching differ from precision tool use and measured damper tuning.
